name: PLATO MISOCP Benchmark
description: Evaluates mixed-integer second-order cone programming (MISOCP) solvers on 47 instances from CBLIB2014 and UC Berkeley, requiring proof of global integer optimality within a 1-hour time limit. The benchmark tests solvers that combine branch-and-bound with conic relaxations to handle both integrality and second-order cone constraints simultaneously.
domain: optimization, conic programming, mixed-integer programming, operations research
reputation: Authoritative MISOCP benchmark maintained by Hans Mittelmann.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. COPT is the only solver to solve all 47 instances. Other solvers have timeouts on harder instances.
